parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(key, value), '{}'::jsonb) AS config
FROM config;

-- Recomputed from posts every run, so running it twice updates rather than pays twice.
-- Integer cents only. The ::bigint matters: sum() returns numeric, which
-- turned the integer division into a decimal one and added a cent to every row.
INSERT INTO payouts
  (creator_id, period_start, period_end, post_count, total_views,
   amount_cents, computed_at)
SELECT c.id, $1::date, $2::date,
       COUNT(p.id)::int,
       COALESCE(SUM(p.views), 0),
       (COALESCE(SUM(p.views), 0)::bigint * c.rate_cents_per_1k + 500) / 1000,
       now()
FROM creators c
LEFT JOIN posts p
  ON p.creator_id = c.id
  AND p.published_at >= $1::date
  AND p.published_at <  $2::date
WHERE c.status = 'active'
GROUP BY c.id, c.rate_cents_per_1k
HAVING (COALESCE(SUM(p.views), 0)::bigint * c.rate_cents_per_1k + 500) / 1000
       >= (SELECT value::int FROM config WHERE key = 'min_payout_cents')
ON CONFLICT (creator_id, period_start, period_end) DO UPDATE
  SET post_count   = EXCLUDED.post_count,
      total_views  = EXCLUDED.total_views,
      amount_cents = EXCLUDED.amount_cents,
      computed_at  = EXCLUDED.computed_at
RETURNING creator_id, amount_cents;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: `payouts ${$json.period_start} to ${$json.period_end}: ${$json.creators} creator(s), ${($json.total_cents / 100).toFixed(2)} EUR (last period ${($json.previous_total_cents / 100).toFixed(2)} EUR)` }) }}
